major: M3 ROLES member is a second identity spelling
M5 sentinel does not guard slice
disposition_of_round1.resolution: see corrected sections below; each maps to a frozen decision.

frozen_identity.mechanism: toolkit-OWNED node kind, the existing stat_test/validate doctrine (node.py register_node_kind(name, cls, owned=True); planner.py:540-543 refuses any non-owned spelling). ReplayRun consumer is a pipeline-owned Node subclass registered under a single pipeline-owned literal REPLAY_RUN_KIND. Identity is the owned kind name, never a uses-string resemblance match, never the document role key, never an import-path text match.
frozen_identity.literal: REPLAY_RUN_KIND = "replay" lives in dskit/pipeline/document.py beside ROLES/MODES as the single owner; the registry registers it owned=True.
frozen_identity.class: The concrete ReplayRun node class and its run() are the FOLLOW-ON slice (F3/F5b/R1). This grammar slice keys the rule on the owned kind NAME, so run() semantics and class registration are out of slice scope; a test-local registry registers a synthetic ReplayRun class to prove the parse-time rule fires on the kind name.
frozen_identity.resolves: C1 (no class resolution needed at parse), C2 (no import; exact equality on an owned literal), M3 (identity is the owned kind, NOT a ROLES member or role key), M4 (positive test is kind-name keyed, independent of run()).

frozen_enforcement.site: parse time in dskit/pipeline/document.py, extending the existing Packet5 grammar: PipelineDocument.from_obj and NodeSpec.__post_init__. The pair rule fires for execution_backtest documents (the same parse path P5 already sweeps), before planning, provider/filesystem, broker, node import, or output creation.
frozen_enforcement.rule: a node whose NodeSpec.uses == REPLAY_RUN_KIND must declare inputs equal to exactly {tape_manifest, tape_data}; each value is a complete legal P5 $captured_artifact descriptor. The replay kind is execution-only: a non-execution document referencing REPLAY_RUN_KIND refuses (parallel to the captured-descriptor execution-only rule).
frozen_enforcement.resolves: C1 (parse-time host reaches execution docs), C2 (no class-ref import).

positive_grammar.pair: inputs == {tape_manifest: {$captured_artifact: D1}, tape_data: {$captured_artifact: D2}}; D1, D2 each an exact P5 six-field descriptor.
positive_grammar.note: D1 and D2 equality/roles are follow-on verification, explicitly NOT grammar.

cases: a third input key beside the pair (descriptor or ordinary wire)
a renamed port (any name other than the exact two) carrying a descriptor
a third key naming one of the two roots
a descriptor as a list/map input value
a $captured_artifact under a non-top-level input position

port names not exactly tape_manifest/tape_data (covers the grammar-level half of 'swapped': manifest and data descriptors exchanged between the two names is follow-on content verification, out of slice)
uses string merely containing 'replay' is not identified
a non-ReplayRun node declaring the two tape ports is not swept into the pair rule
an import-path class ref spelling ReplayRun is not identified by string (it is refused as non-owned at plan, but the pair rule does not key on it)

removed_from_grammar_slice.duplicate_identical: D1 == D2 on the two ports is follow-on verification (same-admission conflict), not grammar.
removed_from_grammar_slice.swapped_content: manifest-shaped vs data-shaped descriptor CONTENT is follow-on verification, not grammar.
removed_from_grammar_slice.equal_port: equal ConsumerCapturedPort with different captures is follow-on verification, not grammar.
removed_from_grammar_slice.resolves: M1, M2 (no contradictory or unfalsifiable grammar rows; the removed families are recorded as follow-on).

compatibility.p4_replay: pair rule fires ONLY on uses == REPLAY_RUN_KIND; accepted P4 final-replay fixtures with generic bundle/second inputs of cardinality one or two remain green.
compatibility.p5_p6: per-descriptor shape (P5) and generic equality (P6) unchanged.
compatibility.ordinary_docs: non-execution documents without the replay kind are byte/hash-identical.
compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; no new module-level non-stdlib import; the replay kind literal and rule live in document.py.

forbidden_effects: planning or stage compilation completes before grammar refusal
identifying ReplayRun by a uses-string resemblance or the document role key
entry_points: dskit.pipeline.driver.plan_document / run_document (refuse before planning via the parse-time rule)
dskit.pipeline.__main__ cmd_plan / cmd_run / cmd_validate / cmd_staged / cmd_walkforward (same parse path)
dskit.pipeline.planner.plan (unchanged; continues to refuse execution docs for ordinary planning)

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_replay_tape_descriptors.py: positive pair + missing/extra/aliased/nested/wrong_name/identity families; ordinary-doc replay-kind refusal; compatibility (P4 generic cardinality unaffected).
tests.sentinel_note: M5 accepted: tests/production/test_capture_lifecycle.py::test_private_plan_precedes_capture does NOT guard this slice (class-blind broker path); it is retained as a general regression check only, not claimed as this slice's guard. The slice's guard is the new test_replay_tape_descriptors.py plus the extended test_captured_artifact_grammar.py.
